title: The Factors of Production

chapter_outcomes: Definition and examples of the economic problem in the contexts of: consumers; workers; producers; and governments.
The difference between economic goods and free goods.

The causes of changes in the quantity and quality of the various factors.

The influence of opportunity cost on decisions making by consumers, workers, producers and governments when allocating their resources.
Definition, drawing and interpretation of appropriate diagrams of Production possibility curve (PPC)
The significance of the location of production points.
Movements along a PPC and opportunity cost.
The causes and consequences of shifts in a PPC in terms of an economy's growth.
